pages.text: Writes a message to the chat.

The chat shows $(1)[program/PID] message$(), e.g. $(1)[farm/3] The farm is full!$(), without the name of a player in front. With $(1)player$(), only that player gets it, in any dimension; if they are not online, INVALID_ARGUMENT is raised.
Without $(1)player$(), all players in the dimension of the trigger block get it who are at most 64 blocks away from it. The server can change the distance with the setting sayRadius.
$(li)$(1)message$() STRING: the message$(li)$(1)player$() STRING: the name of one player (optional, default empty for all players nearby)
$(1)CALL c0de/minecraft/SAY$(br)  PARAMETER message "The farm is full!" ;$(br)  PARAMETER player "Alex" ;$()
